title: Read-only federation quiescence diagnostics: expose counts of pending sender intents, non-terminal executor operations and outstanding remote mailbox requests
outcome: An operator can prove, from one read-only host API call per host, that no cross-host mailbox work is pending or in flight before a controlled upgrade: counts (and bounded lists) of non-terminal sender intents, non-terminal executor operations and wakes, and outstanding remote mailbox requests/permits, each with its source of truth.
acceptance: A read-only endpoint reports, per host, the counts of non-terminal sender mailbox intents (not only lookup by a known key), non-terminal executor operations and pending central wakes, and the current outstanding remote mailbox request permits/receiver jobs, each labelled durable or process-local; tests show each count changes with real fixture work and returns to zero when it settles, and the response reports a quiescent boolean with named reasons, every list bounded and metadata-only.
The full gate passes on the exact final input that lands, with an independent review pair and no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding on that input.
